description: This file implements functions, operators, and classes related to the SPDY protocol, including frame type handling, priority and weight conversions, and frame size calculations within the quiche/spdy core module.

classes.name: SpdyFrameIR
classes.description: Base class for SPDY frame representations, providing common interface and properties.

classes.name: SpdyFrameWithFinIR
classes.description: Derived class for frames with a fin flag, extending SpdyFrameIR.

classes.name: SpdyFrameWithHeaderBlockIR
classes.description: Frame class that includes header block data, extending SpdyFrameWithFinIR.

classes.name: SpdyDataIR
classes.description: Represents SPDY data frames with payload and flow control logic.

classes.name: SpdyRstStreamIR
classes.description: Represents RST_STREAM frames with error codes.

classes.name: SpdySettingsIR
classes.description: Represents SETTINGS frames with a collection of settings.

classes.name: SpdyGoAwayIR
classes.description: Represents GOAWAY frames with last good stream ID and error code.

classes.name: SpdyHeadersIR
classes.description: Represents HEADERS frames with header blocks.

methods.name: operator<<(ostream&, SpdyKnownSettingsId)
methods.description: Outputs the string representation of a SpdyKnownSettingsId.

methods.name: operator<<(ostream&, SpdyFrameType)
methods.description: Outputs the string representation of a SpdyFrameType.

methods.name: ClampSpdy3Priority
methods.description: Clamps a SpdyPriority to the valid SPDY v3 range.

methods.name: ClampHttp2Weight
methods.description: Clamps an HTTP/2 weight value within valid range.

methods.name: Spdy3PriorityToHttp2Weight
methods.description: Converts SPDY v3 priority to HTTP/2 weight.

methods.name: Http2WeightToSpdy3Priority
methods.description: Converts HTTP/2 weight to SPDY v3 priority.

methods.name: IsDefinedFrameType
methods.description: Checks if a frame type byte corresponds to a known SPDY frame type.

methods.name: ParseFrameType
methods.description: Parses a byte into a SpdyFrameType, with bug check if undefined.

methods.name: SerializeFrameType
methods.description: Serializes a SpdyFrameType into a byte.

methods.name: IsValidHTTP2FrameStreamId
methods.description: Validates if a frame stream ID is valid for a given frame type.

methods.name: FrameTypeToString
methods.description: Returns string name for a given SpdyFrameType.

methods.name: ParseSettingsId
methods.description: Parses a wire setting ID into a known settings ID, with validation.

methods.name: SettingsIdToString
methods.description: Returns string name for a given SpdySettingsId.

methods.name: ParseErrorCode
methods.description: Converts a wire error code into a SpdyErrorCode enum.

methods.name: ErrorCodeToString
methods.description: Returns string name for a SpdyErrorCode.

methods.name: WriteSchedulerTypeToString
methods.description: Returns string name for a WriteSchedulerType.

methods.name: GetNumberRequiredContinuationFrames
methods.description: Calculates number of continuation frames needed for a given size.

methods.name: GetHeaderFrameSizeSansBlock
methods.description: Calculates size of header frame sans header block.

methods.name: GetPushPromiseFrameSizeSansBlock
methods.description: Calculates size of push promise frame sans header block.
